kpis.label: Interest cover
kpis.definition: Operating income divided by interest expense.

kpis.label: Dividend yield
kpis.definition: Indicated dividend divided by the latest close.

kpis.label: Return on invested capital
kpis.definition: After-tax operating income divided by invested capital.

kpis.label: Revenue mix disclosure
kpis.definition: 3 disclosed segments. A single consolidated line is not treated as a segment split.
